messages:
Maya (docs): Opened PR to clarify region availability and add brief Brazil + HK footnotes, plus updated SDK examples to show region env + header pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2210

Owen (i18n): Quick note: avoid definitive language like 'data is stored in'. Use 'data residency options may be available' wording. I can draft a 1-line pt-BR and zh-HK footnote.

Priya (SDK): Snippet uses `X-Region` atm; should be `X-Redwood-Region`. Also show client-level region via env var. Suggested example:
```js
const REGION = process.env.REDWOOD_REGION || 'us-east-1'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ region: REGION, apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'Hi' })
// per-request header (hosted/private)
fetch('/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-west-1' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt }) })
```

Hector (legal): Please do not imply guarantees. Recommend: "Data residency options are available in select regions; customers should consult their contract or account team for guarantees and audit logs." Link to Private & SLA pages.

Maya (docs): Thanks — will switch header name, add env var client example, include Hector's phrasing and links. Owen, can you drop the one-line pt-BR/zh-HK footnotes here?

Owen (i18n): PT-BR draft: "Op75es de residancia de dados est3o dispondveis em regi5es selecionadas; consulte seu contrato ou equipe de conta para detalhes."
ZH-HK draft (traditional): "" (localization lead requested to review; will post corrected string in thread shortly).

DeployBot: Preview site built for pr/2210: https://deploy-preview-redwood-docs.netlify.app/pr-2210/regions.html

Priya (SDK): One more accuracy note: Dedicated capacity ignores per-request region header; add parenthetical: "(Note: Dedicated capacity customers should use their account-configured pool; per-request region header applies to Hosted and Private control-plane routing.)"

Maya (docs): Added parenthetical and links, fixed snippet to remove hardcoded model. Pushed update and plan to merge after Owen's localization check and Hector's final signoff.

Hector (legal): LGTM once SLA link verified.

Owen (i18n): Localization lead fixed the zh-HK string and approved both short footnotes.

Maya (docs): Merging in ~5 unless any objections. :rocket:
